summary: The Republic of Uruguay filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a debt offering of Ps. 52,177,088,971 8.000% Global Bonds due 2035, a further issuance fungible with existing bonds, increasing total outstanding to Ps. 106,195,366,891. The offering is a routine sovereign debt issuance, not a special situation. Terms include a public offering price of 101.587% of principal, underwriting discount of 0.096%, and proceeds of 101.491%. Settlement is on or about August 5, 2026 via DTC, Euroclear, and Clearstream, with listing on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. No special-situation elements are present; this is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
